_source: Hand-verified against live discovery runs on docker-test (Debian 13 VM) and vpp0221 (Proxmox/ZFS), 2026-07-30.
_why: These checks pass every automatic gate — they run a GENERIC data source that genuinely exists on the host, then attribute it to something else. No platform rule and no data-source evidence can see through that, so they are listed by hand for re-translation. `reason` records what the check actually reads versus what it claims, which is the input a translation pass needs.

postgres_instances.reason: finds no postgres process and returns OK anyway; must report absence (empty discovery / UNKNOWN)

postgres_processes.reason: same as postgres_instances — no postgres on the host, still graded OK

db2_version.reason: reads the password file to look for a DB2 instance user, finds none, reports a version anyway

podman_container_memory.reason: podman is not installed; must probe for the podman binary and report absence

libelle_business_shadow_process.reason: the Libelle product is not on the host; discovered a service regardless

cadvisor_if.reason: substitutes the host's own NIC counters for cAdvisor's container metrics — a different product entirely; lnx_if already covers local NICs

isc_dhcpd.reason: no dhcpd on the host; must return empty discovery when the config/daemon is missing

nfsmounts.reason: treats EVERY mount as an NFS mount (14 items on a host with no NFS at all); must filter by filesystem type nfs/nfs4

nfsexports.reason: reports exports on a host that serves none; absence must be an empty discovery

lsi_array.reason: no LSI controller present; dmidecode succeeding is not evidence of one

cmk_inv.reason: Checkmk-site internal, not a host check — should not be in the library at all

lvm_vgs.reason: DATA IS REAL (the host has these volume groups) but discovery yields one item per LOGICAL VOLUME instead of one per volume group — 10 items for 2 VGs, with duplicates. Dedupe by vg_name.
